$comment: Single source of truth for triage labels. The allowlist in .github/workflows/issue-triage.md must match 'agentMayApply' (checked by scripts/check-config.mjs in CI).

type.bug: Something in ctx-log behaves differently from its README or types
type.enhancement: Request for a new feature or a change to existing behaviour
type.question: Usage question; no change to the library is requested
type.documentation: README, CHANGELOG or doc-comment problem only

area.area/logger: Logger class, global logger, levels, Fatal/exit behaviour (src/log/logger.ts, src/log/level.ts, src/index.ts)
area.area/writers: IWriter / ILevelWriter, MultiLevelWriter, FilteredLevelWriter, Stdout/Discard writers (src/log/writer.ts, src/writers/writers.ts)
area.area/console: ConsoleWriter pretty output and colours (src/writers/console.ts, src/consts/colors.ts)
area.area/json: Event fields and JSON encoding (src/log/event.ts, src/log/context.ts, src/json/append.ts)
area.area/build: Packaging, ESM/CJS output, type declarations, CI, changesets (package.json, tsconfig.json, .github/workflows/main.yml)

status.needs-info: Reporter must supply missing details before a maintainer can act
status.possible-duplicate: Deterministic search found a likely earlier report; a maintainer decides
